The public trail closes when the visitor completes the quizzes in the 12 modules. The conclusion remains local to the browser, without registration and without sending data.

Read the module and run the corresponding script.
:::

::: {.modules-completion-step role="listitem"}
**2 · Validate**

Take the quiz and record local progress.
:::

::: {.modules-completion-step role="listitem"}
**3 · Generate**

Open the certificate when all modules are complete.
:::
:::

## Trail phases

::: {.phase-grid role="list" aria-label="Trail phases"}
::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**01 · Fundamentals**

Modules 01-02 present the logic of animal breeding and the genetic decomposition of the phenotype.

[Start phase](modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Start the fundamentals phase with Module 01"}
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**02 · Data and parameters**

Modules 03-06 connect exploration, variance, heritability, repeatability, and correlations.

[Start phase](modulo03-estatistica-descritiva-e-exploracao-de-dados-no-r.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Start the data and parameters phase with Module 03"}
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**03 · Modeling**

Modules 07-09 move into linear mixed models, BLUP, pedigree and parentage.

[Start phase](modulo07-modelos-lineares-e-modelos-mistos.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Start the modeling phase with Module 07"}
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**04 · Genomics**

Modules 10-12 introduce SNPs, quality control, genomic arrays, GWAS and prediction.

[Start phase](modulo10-introducao-a-genomica-e-marcadores-snp.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Start the genomics phase with Module 10"}
:::
:::

::: {.modules-evidence-standard role="region" aria-label="Expected evidence in each module"}
::: {.modules-evidence-standard-copy}
**Each module must leave evidence**

Before moving forward, produce a verifiable technical sentence. Each module page now spells out the short study session and closing check: question, R evidence, quiz, and applied decision you would defend.
:::

::: {.modules-evidence-standard-grid role="list" aria-label="Evidence standard per module"}
::: {.modules-evidence-standard-item role="listitem"}
**Concept**

Which biological or statistical question was clearer?
:::

::: {.modules-evidence-standard-item role="listitem"}
**Variation**

Which parameter did you change in the script?
:::

::: {.modules-evidence-standard-item role="listitem"}
**Decision**

What practical consequence did you record before the quiz?
:::
:::
:::

## All modules

::: {.module-grid role="list" aria-label="All course modules"}
::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**01**

[Introduction to Animal Improvement](modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.qmd)

Objectives, response to selection and organization of breeding programs.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**02**

[Bases of Quantitative Genetics](modulo02-bases-da-genetica-quantitativa.qmd)

Genetic value, phenotype, environment and decomposition of observed variation.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**03**

[Descriptive statistics and exploration in R](modulo03-estatistica-descritiva-e-exploracao-de-dados-no-r.qmd)

First diagnoses, data distribution and exploratory interpretation.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**04**

[Means, variances and components](modulo04-medias-variancias-e-componentes-de-variancia.qmd)

Phenotypic, genetic and environmental variance as a basis for decisions.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**05**

[Heritability and repeatability](modulo05-herdabilidade-e-repetibilidade.qmd)

Parameters that connect individual observations to genetic predictability.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**06**

[Genetic and phenotypic correlations](modulo06-correlacoes-geneticas-e-fenotipicas.qmd)

Relationships between characteristics and indirect consequences of selection.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**07**

[Linear and mixed models](modulo07-modelos-lineares-e-modelos-mistos.qmd)

Statistical structure to combine fixed, random and error effects.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**08**

[BLUP and genetic evaluation](modulo08-blup-e-avaliacao-genetica.qmd)

Prediction of genetic values ​​and comparison of selection candidates.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**09**

[Pedigree and kinship](modulo09-estrutura-de-pedigree-e-parentesco.qmd)

Use of pedigree, relationship matrices and connections between individuals.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**10**

[Genomics and SNP markers](modulo10-introducao-a-genomica-e-marcadores-snp.qmd)

Input of molecular markers in data evaluation and control.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**11**

[Genomic quality control](modulo11-controle-de-qualidade-de-dados-genomicos.qmd)

Filters, genotype consistency and preparation for genomic analysis.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**12**

[Genomic arrays, GWAS and prediction](modulo12-matrizes-genomicas-gwas-e-predicao-genomica.qmd)

Integration between genomic relatedness, association and genomic prediction.
:::
:::
